name: neural-bursts
description: Neural Bursts: two 4K Remotion compositions (Three.js / WebGL 2), two versions each

scripts.render:all-4k: remotion render NeuralBurst-V1 out/NeuralBurst-V1-4K.mp4 && remotion render NeuralBurst-V2 out/NeuralBurst-V2-4K.mp4 && remotion render NeuronFiring-V1 out/NeuronFiring-V1-4K.mp4 && remotion render NeuronFiring-V2 out/NeuronFiring-V2-4K.mp4
scripts.render:all-1080p: remotion render NeuralBurst-V1 out/NeuralBurst-V1-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render NeuralBurst-V2 out/NeuralBurst-V2-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render NeuronFiring-V1 out/NeuronFiring-V1-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render NeuronFiring-V2 out/NeuronFiring-V2-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5
